name: anyone-can-code
description: Reliability workflow for OpenAI Codex (Desktop + CLI, one plugin). Auto memory on Desktop and CLI when hooks are trusted.

interface.shortDescription: Codex Desktop + CLI (one plugin): plan → build → verify. Auto memory when hooks trusted.
interface.longDescription: Anyone Can Code is a free open-source reliability workflow plugin for OpenAI Codex. One install for Desktop and CLI. Trust ACC hooks on either host for offline auto memory (v2.0.0-beta.5). Plan, build, resume, recover, and verify in plain English. Desktop-only host UI (Scheduled, Sites) stays on Desktop. Open beta.
defaultPrompt: I want to build something, but I may be starting from an idea, a repo, or a bug.
Resume my last workflow and tell me the next best step.
Verify what changed and tell me what is still uncertain.
